issue.title: Document local-only run workflow
issue.body:
### Context

Epic #119 pivot: we are **not** documenting mobile mock seed (#106) or `EXPO_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_MODE` (#107). Mobile SQLite is populated via **sync hydration** (`syncAllData()`).

### Current state in baseline

- `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` exists; `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md` for QA preview APKs.
- Toolchain: `npm start`, `npm run android`, `npm run prebuild`, `npm test`.
- Env: `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` via `src/config/apiBaseUrl.ts`; `.env.example` provided.
- No doc yet covers **both** dev paths (hosted dev + local Docker).

### Problems / why

- New contributors don't have a single page explaining how to run against hosted dev or local Docker, so they get blocked on API URL / setup confusion.

### Target design

Add `docs/guides/local-development-workflow.md` (linked from `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` and README) covering:

**Path A — Hosted dev:** `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://dev.api.fluent.bible`; log in with a team dev account; shared Postgres — do not seed.

**Path B — Local Docker:** in `fluent-api`, `./fapi.sh up` + `./fapi.sh db:init`; mobile `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://10.0.2.2:9999`; login `t@fluent.local` / `t@123456`.

Also cover: prerequisites (Node ≥ 24.14.0, npm, Android emulator/dev client), setup commands, web app at https://dev.app.fluent.bible, what works after sync vs server-required features, CI test command.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Local development workflow guide exists and is linked from onboarding + README.
- [ ] Documents **both** hosted dev and local Docker paths with exact commands.
- [ ] Documents offline vs server-required features (sync, upload need server).
- [ ] No references to obsolete `@env`, `FLUENT_USER_EMAIL`, or descoped #106/#107 mock mode.
- [ ] Commands match current `package.json`.

### Test plan / verification

Docs-only. Run:

```bash
npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --ci
```

### Out of scope

- Mobile mock seed (#106), offline mock mode (#107) — descoped.
- fluent-api local dev data seeder — separate fluent-api issue.

### Links

- Epic: #119
- fluent-api local stack: [PR #187](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/pull/187)
